structures.label: Psoas minor
structures.description: Optional slender muscle from T12–L1 bodies/disc to the iliopubic region and iliac fascia. It does not cross the hip joint.

structures.label: Lumbar plexus
structures.description: Network of L1–L4 ventral rami in posterior psoas major with the major named lumbar branches. L4 also contributes to the lumbosacral trunk.
keyPoints: Network of L1–L4 ventral rami in posterior psoas major with the major named lumbar branches. L4 also contributes to the lumbosacral trunk.

structures.label: Lumbosacral trunk

structures.label: Sacral plexus

keyPoints: Network of the lumbosacral trunk and S1–S4 ventral rami on the anterior surface of piriformis, with major sciatic, gluteal, posterior-femoral-cutaneous and pudendal pathways.
This partial teaching network does not depict every small branch. Ventral and dorsal fibre divisions are not rendered as physically separated roots. It is not an opaque solid organ.

structures.label: Superficial branch of lateral plantar nerve

structures.limits: Digital branch courses are illustrative; muscular twigs and communication with medial plantar nerve are described, not all drawn.

structures.label: Deep branch of lateral plantar nerve

keyPoints: Deep branch turns medially with the lateral plantar artery, deep to the flexor tendons and adductor hallucis, toward central intrinsic muscles.
